about: Hand-labelled chatbot intents. 'examples' are what the classifier compares a message with (nearest example wins). 'evaluation' is a separate held-out set, never used as examples, that evaluate_intent_accuracy scores against. Labels were assigned by hand; the evaluation phrasings were written independently of the examples.
